controls.name: Picture mode
controls.notes: Read back on this model. Its capabilities list 15(01 06 11 13 14 28 29 32 48) is stale LG firmware text; ddccontrol-db shows the same wire values for Reader, Custom, Color Weakness, FPS, RTS and HDR Effect on other LG models. Custom (Game), Photo and Vivid are named from the owner's menu (#29). Hidden 2 behaves as Custom but loads Custom's defaults, not the owner's settings.

controls.name: Input source
controls.notes: Standard 0x60 writes do not switch this model. LG alternate input (source 0x50, VCP 0xF4) confirmed on the reporter's 29U531A in the ddcutil wiki page Switching input source on LG monitors. One HDMI port.

controls.name: OSD lock
controls.notes: On locks the monitor's own menu; set Off over DDC/CI to unlock it.

controls.name: Aspect ratio
controls.notes: Full Wide stretches to 21:9, Cinema 1 crops to 21:9. 0x01 and 0x02 match ddccontrol-db for other LG models.

controls.name: Response time
controls.notes: Names as in LG's menu; ddccontrol-db labels the same values High, Middle and Low on other LG models.

controls.name: FreeSync
controls.notes: From LG models that list the same F8(00 01); not yet confirmed on this one. Some LG models use 0x02 Basic and 0x03 Extended instead.

controls.name: Black Stabilizer
controls.notes: The menu and the value read back go 0 to 100 in steps of 5; a write takes 0 to 20, so values are sent divided by 5 (#29, from the owner of this model).

controls.name: 1ms Motion Blur Reduction
controls.notes: Reported by the contributor, but not in this model's capabilities string, so DispCtrl does not offer it.

controls.name: Power LED
controls.notes: From older LG models with the same FD(00 01); not yet confirmed on this one.

controls.name: Gamma
controls.notes: Discrete modes per FE(00 01 02), not a range. The menu calls them Mode 1, Mode 2 and so on (#29); that 0x00 is Mode 1 is assumed from the order and not yet confirmed, so it stays read-only.

controls.name: Power mode
controls.notes: Switched off with 0x04, this model flashes black and green with no backlight and does not wake until it is unplugged (#30). DispCtrl does not switch it off; Turn off displays blacks it out instead.
